rules.goal: Move from discovery to useful knowledge
Turn an idea into a structured creation
Discover products and services with transparent terms

requirements: Every journey has a visible recovery path.
Primary navigation must not depend on animation.
A destination must expose its purpose before commitment.
Authentication-required actions must explain the requirement.
Failed network actions must expose retry and preserve user input when safe.
_note: Paths are validated by scripts/user-journey-contract.py against the real deployment surface: a file in the repo root (vercel.json sets cleanUrls, so /gateway serves gateway.html) or a vercel.json rewrite/redirect source. /discover and /community were declared here for a long time and never existed; the surfaces that do the job are gateway.html (omega-gateway.js builds the destination grid) and social.html (SOCIAL HUB).
